title: Parasaurolophus horn call (sound design from real animal recordings)
author: DigiZoo sound design from recordings by National Park Service; NPS / Shan Burson
changes: Movie-style dinosaur call: no recordings of dinosaurs exist, so it was designed from real animal recordings (elk bugle and sandhill crane calls pitched down an octave into a hollow horn, then layered). Sound design from 2 real recordings: "Elk bugle (NPS Sound Gallery)" 8.35–9.55 s, slowed to 0.5× speed (pitched down 50%); "Yellowstone sound library - Sandhill Crane - 002" 9.50–10.40 s, slowed to 0.55× speed (pitched down 45%), placed at 0.20 s; then mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 40 Hz, added reverb, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
